Collectly helps healthcare organizations collect patient payments, automate, and streamline internal revenue cycle operations, and elevate the patient financial experience. It also helps hospitals and health systems boost self-pay and after-insurance-responsibility engagement.

about_short_description.short_description: Collectly helps healthcare organizations increase collections, automate billing operations, and elevate the patient financial experience.

product.name: Collectly AI Revenue Cycle Platform
product.description: A healthcare revenue cycle management platform that automates patient financial workflows from pre-visit eligibility and estimates through billing, payments, and account resolution.

product.name: Post-Visit Billing Automation
product.description: Automates patient billing after care through digital and paper statements, reminders, omnichannel outreach, payment options, and AI-supported billing assistance.

product.name: Payments Platform
product.description: Provides payment infrastructure for patient financial workflows, including card-on-file storage, autopay, payment plans, recurring payments, refunds, adjustments, and digital wallets.

product.name: Billie AI Voice
product.description: An AI-powered patient billing agent that provides 24/7 voice and chat support for billing questions, payment options, insurance details, and balance resolution.

product.name: AI Eligibility & Benefits
product.description: Automates insurance eligibility verification and benefits interpretation, including coverage checks, copay determination, additional coverage discovery, and payer portal data retrieval.

product.name: AI Cost Estimation
product.description: Estimates a patient’s expected financial responsibility before care using coverage, allowed amounts, coordination of benefits, and applicable Good Faith Estimate requirements.
